This was Mao Zedong's last public appearance, and the last known photograph of him alive. It shows him on May 27, 1976 meeting Pakistani Prime Minister Zulfikar Ali Bhutto during his one day visit to Beijing. Mao suffered two major heart attacks in 1976, one in March and another in July, before a third struck on September 5, rendering him an invalid. Mao Zedong died on September 9, 1976, at age 82.
